## Install

1. Download **Ebb.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Drag **Ebb** into your **Applications** folder.
3. Open it. macOS will say it can't verify the developer the first time. Go to
   **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
   (Or in Terminal: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Ebb.app`)
4. Look for the waves icon in the menu bar, top right.

Needs macOS 14 Sonoma or newer. Works on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
